description: Ten-layer von Karman atmosphere used by ESO's OCTOPUS end-to-end AO simulations for the E-ELT Design Reference Mission PSF database.

provenance.note: Values copied verbatim from the 'Atmosphere' and 'Parameters of layers' tables of ESO's E-ELT DRM technical-data page 'AO performance and PSFs'. Fractional Cn2 weights are as published and sum to 1.001 because of rounding; shwfs_ao renormalizes them on load. Wind directions are not published.
references: ESO E-ELT Design Reference Mission, Database of technical data: AO performance and PSFs (OCTOPUS simulation parameters)
Le Louarn et al. 2004, Proc. SPIE 5490, 705 (OCTOPUS)
Le Louarn et al. 2005, ESO E-ELT AO simulation note (linked from the ESO DRM page)

notes: Altitudes are heights above the telescope, as tabulated by ESO.
The published seeing (0.8 arcsec) is the rounded Kolmogorov value 0.98*lambda/r0 = 0.78 arcsec at 500 nm; r0 is the primary quantity.

ESO's simulations used 500 Hz frame rate, 2000 iterations (4 s), a 3-iteration delay, 84x84 Shack-Hartmann sub-apertures and an 85x85 actuator DM; those are system, not atmosphere, parameters and are not part of this profile.
